result.summary: Reproduced TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's Step 3b counts from a cold start rather than trusting the prior claim. Confirmed toolchain available locally (Elixir 1.20.3 / Erlang OTP 29 on PATH) and Postgres already up (letflow-postgres-1, healthy, port 5462) via `docker compose ps`. Ran `mix test` (full suite, unpinned seed 426923): 'Result: 597 passed (4 properties, 593 tests)', exit code 0, 0 failures, full raw log (11,729 lines) captured and grepped for failure markers (Failures:/Failure:/** (/Excluded:/Skipped:/ failure[s],) with zero matches beyond the passing summary itself. Ran `mix test --seed 0` (full suite, pinned seed, second independent run): identical 'Result: 597 passed (4 properties, 593 tests)', exit code 0, 0 failures, same zero-match grep check. Ran the new/changed REQ-031 files in isolation (service_scope_validator_test.exs, store_test.exs, definitions_test.exs): 'Result: 67 passed', exit code 0, 0 failures -- exactly matching the count TEST-DESIGNER and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR each independently claimed. Verified the count arithmetic directly rather than assuming it: counted 24 tests in service_scope_validator_test.exs via grep against the actual file, and 3 new tests added to store_test.exs via `git diff main...HEAD`; 566 + 24 + 3 = 593 tests / 570 + 27 = 597 total, matching both full-suite runs exactly. Investigated two compiler warnings not previously named in a prior report ('the following clause will never match' in test/letflow/event_store/registry_test.exs:654, 'comparison between distinct types found' in test/letflow/definitions/snapshot_store_test.exs:253) before dismissing them: confirmed via `git diff main...HEAD --stat` that neither file is part of this branch's 16-file diff (last touched by the unrelated REQ-033 commit on main) -- pre-existing, unrelated to REQ-031, and not failures (0 failures in both full runs), so not filed to ISSUE_QUEUE. Noted ISS-0036 (docs/issues/ISS-0036.yaml) was already filed by SECURITY-REVIEWER upstream in this same run's Step 2c -- not discovered by this step, referenced for completeness only, not re-filed. No pre-existing failures found anywhere in the suite. Nothing routed back to ELIXIR-DEV or TEST-DESIGNER. Wrote test/reports/report-2026-08-18-WF02-REQ031-20260817.yaml with full real evidence (seeds, exit codes, verbatim summary/finished lines, grep checks, count cross-checks, known-noise inventory) and committed it (commit 89d408e).
